name: Grill Imbiss Rennweg
kurzbeschreibung:
**BBQ Snack Stand Rennweg in Tirol**

---
**Welcome to the heart of Innsbruck!**

At **Grill Imbiss Rennweg**, we serve up the best **Tiroler** flavors right by the **Inn River**. Whether you're craving a juicy **Wiener Würstchen**, a crispy **Leberkäse** sandwich, or a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh fruit compote—our menu has something for every taste.

**Why visit us?**
✔ **Fresh & tasty** – Only the best ingredients from **Tirol** and beyond.
✔ **Quick & easy** – Perfect for a snack after sightseeing or a break during your hike.
✔ **Cozy atmosphere** – Enjoy your meal at our outdoor seating by the river or take it to go.

**Must-try specialties:**
🔥 **Grillplatten** – A mountain of meat, sausages, and veggies, grilled to perfection.
🍟 **Tiroler Knödel** – Soft, fluffy dumplings with your choice of filling.
🍺 **Local beers & drinks** – Refreshing **Tiroler** craft beers and cold **Apfelschorle**.

**Location:**
📍 **Rennweg 12, 6020 Innsbruck** – Just a short walk from **Innsbruck’s Old Town** and **Nordkettebahn**.

**Opening hours:**
🕒 **Daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM** (weather permitting).

**Come by and taste the real **Tirol**!** 🏔️🍴
